title: Cover the Human intake deadline guard when a newer queue decision wins
outcome: An injected-time regression verifies that a late initial Human persistence deadline cannot change the newer pause, Stop or active-turn state, and the original queued prompt is retained once.
acceptance: After the real initial Human row fence is captured, use a normal queue or turn owner to change a captured generation. Advance the scripted clock and verify the newer status, preview and pause survive and the original prompt appears once without a provider send.
